facts.description:
View 1592 Nanton Avenue V6J 2X2 rent availability including the monthly rent price and browse photos of this 3 bed, 3 bath, 1630 Sq. Ft. apartment. 1592 Nanton Avenue is currently on market.
A brand-new luxury duplex on a quiet, tree-lined street in Shaughnessy, set on a 10,000 square foot lot. Three bedrooms plus a den, three and a half bathrooms, across approximately 1,630 square feet. Available 1 September, or sooner.

The layout is open-concept and genuinely well planned - the home reads as a private detached residence rather than a duplex. Finishes are uncompromising throughout.

The kitchen is built around high-end custom cabinetry and a full suite of Miele stainless steel appliances. The entire top floor is given over to the primary suite, with a large private deck looking out over the neighbourhood and a sprawling custom walk-in closet.

Bathrooms are finished to a spa standard: floating double vanities, back-lit mirrors, a freestanding soaker tub and seamless glass walk-in showers.

Comfort has been taken seriously. Radiant in-floor heating throughout, full air conditioning, and an HRV system for year-round air quality.

The location is the point. York House School is a short walk. Shaughnessy Elementary and Granville House Montessori are close by, with easy access to West King Edward, Granville Street and downtown.

In-unit laundry. Detached garage with EV charging. Air conditioning. Available 1 September or sooner - please reach out to arrange a viewing.
